introduction.text: Forte Prenestina is a historic fort in Rome’s Prenestino‑Centocelle district, built in the late 19th century and later transformed into a self‑managed social center that hosts cultural events.

history.description: Construction of Forte Prenestina began in 1877 and was completed in 1891 as part of Rome’s fortification system.
The fort was specifically built between 1880 and 1884 on the site of the fourth kilometre of Via Prenestina.
In 1986 the fort was occupied by local youth during the Festa del non lavoro, marking the beginning of its use as a social centre.
The Cordata per l’autoproduzione collective was founded in 1993 within the fort, promoting alternative music production.
The Reali Autentici Sound (RAS) reggae sound‑system events were held at the fort from 1995 to 1997.
The fort hosted the Hackmeeting in 2000, a gathering of hackers and technologists.
The international comics festival Crack! Fumetti dirompenti began in 2005 at the fort.
The independent photography festival OcchiRossi started in 2009 at the fort.
Since 2010 the fort has hosted the Electrode independent electronic music festival and the Partizan Fucina antiautoritaria anti‑fascist festival.
